source_refs.title: Change your Apple Account password - Apple Support
source_refs.section: Change your Apple Account password on your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, or Apple Vision Pro
source_refs.applicability: iPhone; steps apply to a signed-in Apple Account. Trusted device and Stolen Device Protection conditions as stated on the page
source_refs.verified_excerpt: The easiest and most secure way to change your Apple Account password is to use your iPhone or another trusted device
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: Open the Settings app and tap your name. Tap 'Sign-In & Security.' Tap 'Change Password.' Complete the prompts on screen to set a new password. If other devices are signed in to your account, choose 'Remove Other Devices' to require those devices to sign in again, or choose 'Keep All Devices Signed In.' The easiest and most secure way to change your Apple Account password is to use your iPhone or another trusted device. You might be required to wait one hour before changing your Apple Account password.

source_refs.title: Change or reset your password - Computer - Google Account Help
source_refs.section: How do I change my Google Account password?
source_refs.applicability: Computer web browser; signed-in Google Account; sign-in prompts as stated on the page
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Enter your new password, then select Change Password.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On a computer: Open your Google Account. You might need to sign in. At the top left, click 'Security & sign-in.' In the section 'How you sign in to Google,' click 'Password.' You might need to sign in again. Enter your new password, then select 'Change Password.' Changing your password signs you out everywhere except devices you use to verify it's you, some third-party app devices with account access, and helpful home devices with account access.

source_refs.section: Change or reset your password (iPhone and iPad steps)
source_refs.applicability: iPhone or iPad; Google Account signed in on the device
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If you change or reset your password, you'll be signed out everywhere except:
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone or iPad: Launch the Gmail app on your device. At the top right, tap your profile picture or initial, then choose 'Manage your Google Account.' If you don't use Gmail, visit myaccount.google.com instead. Select 'Personal info.' Under 'Other info and preferences for Google services,' tap 'Password.' Enter your new password. Tap 'Next.'
